dataList.dlg: The Noir collection this season is defined by subdued hues and precision tailoring. Customers seeking a heart-constricting fit are invited to visit Le Noir Contemporary Hall on 1F.

Le Rouge's season-exclusive stripe collection casts the supple lines of skin and bone into sharp relief. Customers who are interested in a fit as distinctive as intersecting curves are invited to Le Rouge Contemporary Hall on 1F.
High customer volume is currently causing congestion on the escalators.
Service may be delayed. Customers seeking faster passage are kindly asked to reach an amicable arrangement with the Mannequins.
To enhance the elegance of our exhibitions, we're giving selected Mannequins new seasonal looks. Their movement will remain limited while they are being styled. We appreciate your patience.
To preserve a safe and refined shopping experience, please deposit all golden accessories in a locker or secured valuables cabinet. Lost property may be transferred to new ownership.
Customers wishing to recover clothing material from the floor are invited to visit the Food Court on B1F.
We would like to relay an announcement from the Lost Child Center on 4F. Customers searching for lost children are encouraged to return home.
This floor has high customer traffic, so you may frequently encounter Mannequins. To keep circulation smooth, please avoid lingering in the corridors.
A present tailored after the past. A future cut in the shape of today. Grand Magasin Sisyphe flourishes this season, as always, through the worthy and valuable consumption of our customers.
We are pleased to inform you that sold-out merchandise is now back in stock.
Your attention, please. The Python Season will soon draw to a close. We look forward to offering you an even more exceptional experience next season. Thank you.

Intense sunlight is currently pouring into the corridor. Customers without parasols are advised to remain inside the stores. We also remind you that physical contact between customers and Mannequins is mutually permitted.

Your attention, please. Layout adjustments are underway on 3F to accommodate a new brand. Certain facilities may no longer be where the existing directory indicates. Please remain alert to your surroundings.
For your convenience, Mannequin displays and traffic routes are being reorganized throughout each store.
Unforeseen damage has been observed on selected Mannequins and display ensembles. Store operations on 3F will be suspended while appearances are restored.
Every product at Grand Magasin Sisyphe is presented this season in the form and place most befitting its worth.
The prepared stock of this product has been fully exhausted.

The new season brings every customer's wait to an end. Ladders may now be used for both ascent and descent. To best avoid accidental falls, please take care not to confuse ladders with escalators, slopes, and other structures.
Furnishings that have outlived their usefulness should be returned to the Furniture Hall on 4F. To avoid getting lost, please follow the pouring sunlight.
The Food Court is holding a limited-time sale ahead of the season's close. Customers in search of nostalgic flavors are invited to visit B1F.
Smoking is permitted everywhere in the department store except where prohibited. This policy is in place to prevent fires. We appreciate your cooperation.
Returns and exchanges may not be accepted if the item is not in its original salable condition with the Golden Hide attached.
Your attention, please. When visiting a store to return a product, please bring the Golden Resin or Hide of equivalent quantity and purity to the original item.
Customers who have fallen behind current trends may be restricted from entering certain stores and traveling between floors.

Please be informed that Grand Magasin Sisyphe offers an alteration service. If you have a limited eyeball budget, or if you have fallen behind the latest fashion trends, please pay a visit to be altered into products.
Temporary coverings will soon be placed over certain display windows due to repeated contact between customers and Mannequins. Please keep this in mind when shopping or viewing our displays.

To improve your shopping experience, we are adjusting Mannequin inventory in select stores. Reclaimed Mannequins will be repurposed as clothing material or stored separately in the underground parking lot.
Prestige Tier reassessments are now underway for customers whose purchase history has met the required level.
We hope you enjoy shopping with us again next season.

Thank you for another season of your generous patronage.
*sigh* ... As for you people, I hope you'll one day be able to rise again.
We extend our warmest welcome to the valued guests of Grand Magasin Sisyphe visiting today. Grand Magasin Sisyphe is ever committed to cherishing every experience our customers procure within.
